input.query: SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date < DATE '2025-11-10' THEN 'baseline' ELSE 'recent' END period, CASE WHEN platform='android' AND doc_type='national_id' THEN 'android national_id' ELSE 'other slices' END slice, sum(n_decisions) decisions, sum(n_approved)::DOUBLE/sum(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date < DATE '2025-11-10' THEN 'baseline' ELSE 'recent' END, 'all',sum(n_decisions),sum(n_approved)::DOUBLE/sum(n_decisions) FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1
